system.description: Grants the vampire a perfect internal clock, able to track time to the second and countdown any given interval precisely. He can sense disturbances in the flow of time nearby with a Simple Test; minor disturbances (Basic/Intermediate powers) are sensed up to a mile, Advanced/Master powers up to 10 miles, and the most potent abilities from a hundred to a thousand miles away. Any attempt to alter the character's perception of time must first win a Static Mental Challenge at a difficulty equal to the target's Temporis level. He may also detect nearby Celerity use with a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty seven minus the Celerity level) within 10 yards per level of Temporis he possesses.
